name: Lago Grey beach and the Grey Glacier lookout
region: Torres del Paine National Park, west
why: Over a swinging bridge to a grey beach covered in blue icebergs, with the glacier at the end of the lake.
book: Park entry online (Pases Parques). Lago Grey sector by car or tour; the boat to the glacier face leaves from Hotel Lago Grey (book ahead).
dangers: The bridge takes 6 people at a time.
Wind on the beach and the peninsula.
turnaround: Last entry to Playa Grey 16:00; the beach closes at 19:00 (park rules 2026-27).

points.name: Pingo river hanging bridge
points.note: From the Lago Grey ranger post (Guardería Pingo) over the hanging footbridge on the Pingo river.

points.name: Lago Grey beach with icebergs
points.note: A long grey-pebble beach; icebergs run aground here, the glacier far up the lake.

points.name: Grey Glacier lookout, Isla de los Hielos
points.note: Up the wooded peninsula at the end of the beach: the lookout faces the glacier front across the lake.
